name: Himitsu no Koi
source:
From when did we become lovers? Love comes unexpectedly as an unforgettable memory in a sweet and sour summer time. Just a week before the summer vacations end our secret love began.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-october-2000-baldr-bullet.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
我们从什么时候开始成为恋人的？爱情不期而至，成为酸甜可口的夏日里难忘的回忆。就在暑假结束前一周，我们的秘密爱情开始了。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-october-2000-baldr-bullet.html]vndbreview[/url]]
